name: procedure
summary: A repeatable procedure an agent performs (fill a form, build a slide, file a ticket) packaged as a skill, with its own standing rules, examples and scripts.

work_folders.skill: the skill itself: SKILL.md (router, short), references/, scripts/, assets/
work_folders.output: published results — one current best per stable id; drafts never land here

init_questions: What exactly does the procedure produce, and what is the hard rule that must never be broken (e.g. never submit, never fabricate)?
Which recurring output types exist, and what fields does each need?
Where do the brand/format references live (templates, fonts, example outputs)?
